name: io.github.SCULabs/x402-tools
title: x402 tools
description: Pay-per-call agent tools: web to markdown, screenshots, summaries, extraction. Paid via x402.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the pay-per-call tools offered by x402-tools.com (web page to markdown, screenshots, summarize, structured extraction, translation, image generation, Base wallet lookup, x402 endpoint checker, DNS lookup, email check). Each result has the HTTPS endpoint, method, price in USD, and parameters. Call the endpoint with an x402-capable HTTP client to pay in USDC and get the result. Optionally pass a query describing the task to rank the most relevant tools first.

query.description: Optional task description, e.g. 'read a PDF'

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full details for one tool by id (e.g. 'markdown'): endpoint, method, price, parameters, example output and an example call.

tools.name: markdown
tools.description: Fetches a public URL and converts it to clean markdown, dropping navigation, scripts and styling. Works for HTML pages, PDFs, Word, Excel and CSV files. Returns the page title, final URL after redirects and the markdown text. Paid tool: $0.004 per call in USDC via x402 at GET https://x402-tools.com/v1/markdown. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.

max_chars.description: Truncate the markdown to this many characters (default 100000, max 500000).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Opens the URL in a headless Chrome browser, waits for the page to settle and returns a PNG screenshot. Choose the viewport size and whether to capture the full scrolling page. Returns the image directly, or base64 JSON with format=json. Paid tool: $0.01 per call in USDC via x402 at GET https://x402-tools.com/v1/screenshot. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.

full_page.description: Capture the full scrolling page (default false).

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Summarizes a block of text or the content of a URL (HTML or PDF) using a fast LLM. Pick the length and whether you want prose or bullet points, and optionally a focus such as 'pricing' or 'risks'. Paid tool: $0.008 per call in USDC via x402 at POST https://x402-tools.com/v1/summarize. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.

url.description: URL to summarize (use this or text).

text.description: Text to summarize, up to 30000 characters (use this or url).

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Give it a URL or text plus either a JSON schema or a simple list of field names, and it returns JSON that matches. Good for turning product pages, job posts, invoices, articles or profiles into structured records. Missing values come back as null instead of being made up. Paid tool: $0.01 per call in USDC via x402 at POST https://x402-tools.com/v1/extract. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.

url.description: URL to extract from (use this or text).

text.description: Text to extract from, up to 25000 characters.

fields.description: Simple alternative to schema: a list of field names, or an object of field name to type/description.

schema.description: A JSON schema for the output object.

instructions.description: Optional extra guidance, e.g. 'prices in EUR'.

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translates up to 8000 characters into the target language. The source language is detected automatically. Markdown, line breaks and placeholders are preserved. Paid tool: $0.008 per call in USDC via x402 at POST https://x402-tools.com/v1/translate. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.

target.description: Target language, as a name or code (e.g. 'Dutch' or 'nl').

source.description: Optional source language. Detected if omitted.

tools.name: image
tools.description: Generates a 1024x1024 image from a text prompt with the FLUX.1 [schnell] model. Returns a JPEG directly, or base64 JSON with format=json. Paid tool: $0.02 per call in USDC via x402 at POST https://x402-tools.com/v1/image. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.

steps.description: Diffusion steps, 1 to 8 (default 4). More steps, more detail.

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: Reads an address on Base mainnet: native ETH balance, USDC balance, any extra ERC-20 tokens you list (with symbol, name and decimals), transaction count and whether it is a contract. Paid tool: $0.004 per call in USDC via x402 at GET https://x402-tools.com/v1/wallet. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.

tokens.description: Optional comma-separated ERC-20 contract addresses to include (max 10).

tools.name: x402_check
tools.description: Calls an endpoint without paying and reads its x402 payment requirements (v1 body and v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header). Returns price in USD, network, pay-to address, description, discovery info, latency and a list of setup problems with a grade. Use it before paying an unknown API, or to test your own. Paid tool: $0.004 per call in USDC via x402 at GET https://x402-tools.com/v1/x402-check. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.

method.description: HTTP method to probe with: GET (default) or POST.

tools.name: x402_preflight
tools.description: Give it the x402 endpoints your agent is about to call and your spending rules (per-request cap, total budget, allowed networks). It probes every endpoint without paying, in parallel, and returns which ones are safe to pay, the real price in USD, network and pay-to address of each, the total cost, and a plain reason for every endpoint it blocks (over the cap, over budget, testnet only, not a valid x402 endpoint, non-USD price). Use it as a guardrail step in any agent that spends money. Paid tool: $0.005 per call in USDC via x402 at POST https://x402-tools.com/v1/x402-preflight. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.

urls.description: 1 to 10 x402 endpoint URLs, or objects { url, method } to probe with POST.

max_price_usd.description: Per-request cap in USD. Endpoints that cost more are blocked.

budget_usd.description: Total budget in USD for this batch. Endpoints are approved in order until it runs out.

networks.description: Allowed networks, e.g. ["base"] or ["eip155:8453"]. Default: any mainnet.

tools.name: dns
tools.description: Returns A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT and CAA records, SPF and DMARC policies, and registration data from RDAP (registrar, created, expires, status, nameservers). Paid tool: $0.004 per call in USDC via x402 at GET https://x402-tools.com/v1/dns. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Checks an email address without sending anything: syntax, whether the domain accepts mail (MX records), disposable or throwaway domains, role accounts like info@ or support@, free providers and common typos (gmial.com). Returns a simple verdict. Paid tool: $0.004 per call in USDC via x402 at GET https://x402-tools.com/v1/email-check. Calling it here returns the endpoint, price and how to pay.
